body.x: Kizling (CEO Hye-lim Lee), a leading company in kids' short-form content, showcased its exclusive platform for children and its expert SaaS technology at CES 2025 in Las Vegas, drawing significant attention on the global stage.
At CES 2025, Kizling presented its innovative children's short-form content platform, the only one in Korea. It boasts cutting-edge AI technology integrated with short-form media.
Beyond merely providing content, the platform supports talent discovery and personal growth for children, capturing the interest of visitors and industry experts alike.
Kizling’s AI recommendation engine analyzes children's interests and behavioral data in real-time to offer personalized talent content. This helps young users uncover and develop their skills.

During CES 2025, Kizling demonstrated groundbreaking technologies, including an AI recommendation engine for scientifically analyzing talent content, Personalized content delivery based on user behavior data, and SaaS solutions for experts and educators.

These innovations garnered the attention of global edtech industry representatives. A representative from a UK-based edtech company praised Kizling's technology as “innovative and capable of supporting the growth of individual children, far beyond simple content provision.”
The personalized content delivery technology and SaaS solutions for experts also received acclaim from industry professionals worldwide.

CEO Hye-lim Lee shared, “We are thrilled to receive such positive interest and responses from the first day of CES 2025. This event is an opportunity to showcase Kizling’s technological capabilities to the world and explore new possibilities in children’s content.”
She added, “Our goal is to offer differentiated value in the global market by merging short-form content with talent media.”

Following its successful debut at CES 2025, Kizling plans to expand global collaboration opportunities across AI video, education, media, and content sectors during the event. The company is committed to establishing itself as a leading player in the global kids' content industry by merging short-form and talent media, creating an environment where children can unleash their creativity and talents.
